expectations.text: States this is not a firmware bug and that adding a delay or retrying play() cannot work because the AVPlay native session is dead
expectations.evidence: not a firmware bug; delay+retry retries the wrong op on a destroyed pipeline

expectations.text: Identifies that pause() alone on background leaves the decoder / AVPlay session / DRM session held, and the platform reclaims it (especially when the live-TV tuner takes the shared plane)
expectations.evidence: decoder + video plane preempted by the tuner while suspended; stale handle

expectations.text: Fix tears the player down on background with avplay.stop() then avplay.close() (releasing the instance), not just pause()
expectations.evidence: FAIL: background handler leads with suspend()/restore() ("not pause()"); stop()->close() teardown only appears as a fallback on restore() failure and in stopPlayback(), not as the on-background path the skill prescribes

expectations.text: Fix rebuilds the pipeline on resume (open/prepareAsync + seek to a saved playhead) instead of calling play() on the stale instance
Frames it as the general rule: release the media pipeline and GPU/DRM resources when leaving the foreground
expectations.evidence: close() in teardown; onerror -> rebuild; setDisplayRect after preemption
